JELLY JAM - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-jellyjam.txt.

Welcome to the jam kitchen! Pairs of shiny jellies fall into your jar: move
them, turn them, and put four or more of the same colour together (up, down,
left or right) to melt them. The jellies above fall down and may melt in
turn: a CHAIN. Every melt sends grey rain jellies into your opponent's jar
(your own melts cancel the rain coming to you first); rain only melts when a
group next to it does. A jar filled up to the top loses.

One player: duel the kitchen's chefs one after the other - Pip the mouse,
Dot the duckling, Hopsy the bunny, Mochi the cat, Truffle the piglet, Basil
the fox, Bao the panda and Bruno the bear, the head chef - each one quicker
and cleverer. Lose a duel and it is over. Points for every melt (much more
for chains and big groups) and a bonus for every chef beaten. Medals at
3000, 12000, 35000 and 70000, and your best is kept.

Run JellyJam.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  move the pair             D-pad left / right         arrow keys
  drop faster               D-pad down                 down arrow
  turn clockwise            A (or X)                   X (or V)
  turn counter-clockwise    B (or Y)                   Z (or C)
  start                     A (or B, Start)            X or Enter
  pause / resume            Select (or Start in a duel) Backspace or Esc
  players 2-4 join          A on their pad, on the title (B leaves)
  back to the title         A (or Select) on the results
  touch / mouse             drag left or right: move the pair; tap: turn
                            it; swipe down: drop it; a tap starts

Two to four players: everyone against everyone, side by side, each with
their own pad. The rain goes to the leader (the jar with the least in it),
the last jar standing wins the round, best of three. The results rank
everyone by rounds won.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: JellyJam.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best score is saved in jellyjam.srm next to the exe.
